title: Russian Banderol Cruise Missiles Kill 6 Farm Workers in Stara Hnylytsia, Kharkiv Oblast
detail: Russian forces struck a farm in the village of Stara Hnylytsia, Chuhuiv district, Kharkiv Oblast (roughly 30 km east of Kharkiv city) on the morning of September 24 with three S-8000 Banderol jet-powered cruise missiles. One missile hit a vegetable storage facility where workers were sorting produce, killing 6 (two men and four women) and injuring 12, four of them in serious condition with head and neck injuries. Kharkiv Oblast Military Administration head Oleh Syniehubov confirmed the toll. The same night, Russian strikes elsewhere in Ukraine killed a man and a woman in Kyiv, and drones violated Moldovan airspace (two exploded, no injuries) and Romanian airspace near the border.
